summary: This video breaks down a high-scoring Vortex III team setup imported from Chinese servers featuring an Aura team and a Toxin team. The spotlight is on the Toxin composition utilizing Child of Chaos and Stegamoffyn to ensure team survivability throughout the entire encounter. Notably, the Toxin team achieved 8.2 billion damage with an Inspiration 0 Serpentemis. For players without high Inspiration on Stegamoffyn, survivability can be compensated by stacking higher HP% and Defense% stats on damage dealers. The creator also displays exact hero positioning, vault gear, artifacts like Puppeteer, and skill timings for both teams.
